purpose: Bind a distinct v8 source-only repair of frozen v7 and its fresh independent five-blocker audit. V7, its audit, science, grid, decision, rate, and read rules remain untouched.

repairs.v8_repair: The external preflight first authenticates raw argv0 and the exact manifested stage, copies its exact source bytes to a memfd, applies F_SEAL_SEAL|F_SEAL_SHRINK|F_SEAL_GROW|F_SEAL_WRITE, validates bytes/size/dev/inode/seals/SHA-256, and descriptor-reexecutes those immutable bytes. Its one-shot capability carries that descriptor identity through bootstrap and pre-NumPy core reauthentication. /proc executable and pid/fd bindings are supplemental, never the source-byte trust root; cmdline is unused.

The contract, preflight, and core freeze identical exact schemas and PASS statuses for independent source and runtime audits, plus the untrusted pre-audit runtime-receipt status. Authorization audit sections carry only paths and file/internal digests; required_status is rejected as an additional key.

Preflight opens and authenticates output_existing_parent once with O_DIRECTORY|O_NOFOLLOW and passes that exact descriptor/dev/inode. The core never reopens the output pathname after the gate: absence check, mkdir, run-root open, O_EXCL|O_NOFOLLOW temp create, write/fsync, descriptor-relative rename, run-root fsync, and parent fsync are all dirfd-relative.

Every 48-cell runtime row and every five stable-order adversary emits the complete six-field memory_release object: stream_synchronized, used/total before free, used/total after free, and the explicit all-arrays-deleted flag.

After all affine/gathered/mask/histogram/XKLT consumers finish, build_panel explicitly deletes owning containers and every GPU-bearing loop alias including masks, x, and words, synchronizes, requires used_bytes==0 before free, then requires used_bytes==total_bytes==0 and emits per-expert evidence.

adversarial_source_tests.immutable_preflight_provenance: Five mutations remove sealing, memfd creation, bootstrap byte equality, core byte equality, or reintroduce cmdline provenance; each structural verifier fails.
adversarial_source_tests.hardcoded_pass_contract: Mutating a frozen PASS constant or adding required_status to an authorization audit section fails exact contract validation.
adversarial_source_tests.descriptor_relative_output: Mutations remove output dirfd anchoring, run-root dirfd anchoring, O_EXCL, or parent fsync; each fails the output-commit verifier.
adversarial_source_tests.six_field_memory_rows: Deleting any one of the six fields from either runtime-row shape reduces the required two-ledger AST closure and fails.
adversarial_source_tests.panel_lifetime: Mutations retain masks, x, or words, remove synchronization, remove the pre-free used assertion, or remove post-free used/total closure; each fails.
adversarial_source_tests.preserved_v7_controls: Existing CPU tests retain strict read-valid ranking/coverage, recursive NaN/+infinity/-infinity rejection, numeric-boundary HOLD precedence, early-kill thresholds, and live support-XKLT angle charge.
